args.action: Seamless relaxed ready idle, facing south toward the camera throughout. Very subtle breathing in chest and shoulders, occasional gentle blink, long hair tips and scarf ends sway softly then settle. Both feet remain planted at identical ground coordinates. Sword stays securely in the right hand with small relaxed wrist motion, low and to the side. No walking, no turning, no jumping, no camera motion or scale change. Ends exactly in the starting pose.

A smooth energetic seamless RUN CYCLE in place facing south toward the camera, retaining this exact character design, proportions and scale. Immediately enter a proper running stride: alternate left and right foot forward contacts, knees lift and fold through passing poses, push off into short airborne phases. Hips and torso bob subtly with each stride. Hair and split coat tails trail and rebound with secondary motion. Free arm swings opposite the legs; sword hand carries the blade low diagonally behind beside the hip, never drawing it up to the head. Keep feet and both legs readable, keep character centered in the same location. No turning, no sideways walking, no skating, no levitation, no background or dust. Show two complete alternating steps at a constant rhythm and end on a pose continuing into the first stride.

Sword stays securely in the right hand with small relaxed wrist motion, low and to the side. No walking, no turning, no jumping, no camera motion or scale change. Ends exactly in the starting pose.

Quickly enter an energetic running stride and complete one full left-right cycle, without slowing back to idle. Two distinct foot contacts and pushes, heels flick upward, knees lift through passing poses, hips twist opposite shoulders. IMPORTANT: both arms visibly swing through natural arcs, including the sword arm. Right shoulder leads, elbow bends and extends, wrist follows with a delayed swing; the rigid katana changes angle with the wrist and remains firmly attached to the grip, never frozen in space or rubbery. Free arm counter-swings. Long hair and coat tails flow behind the body's rise and fall with delayed settling. Character stays centered; fixed camera, no turning, no translation across canvas. Entire blade stays visible without clipping. Clear leg separation and body weight, no idle pause, no planted sword arm.
